decisions.reason: Narrative completeness is changed by a separate clause in message 84 and already has its own same-message MODIFY; requiring all eight clips to come from one video does not further change it.
The lesson-value standard is established by a separate clause in message 84 and already has its own same-message MODIFY; the one-video source constraint does not alter that standard.
Selecting all trial clips from one video does not necessarily change the existing requirement to follow the current hook guidelines.
The source-selection constraint does not change the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits.
Visual editing style is changed by a separate clause in message 84 and already has its own same-message MODIFY; the one-video source constraint adds no further visual-style change.
The assigned batch was already eight clips before message 84; requiring those clips to share one source video belongs to source selection and does not change the batch count or delivery obligation.
The one-video source constraint neither changes nor removes the existing caption color treatment.
Message 84 repeats the existing target of 180 approved clips per month, while the source-selection change applies only to the eight-clip trial batch.
Choosing one source video for the trial clips does not change the caption-font requirement or its prior verification.
